part_name: OZ51x Dual-RX Vertical Housing — GPT-5.6 Sol Production Refinement
description: Production-oriented industrial-design refinement of the vertically stacked RF + TTL receiver housing by GPT-5.6 Sol. All module, connector, mounting, wiring-access, fiber, and keep-out interfaces remain inherited and unchanged.
material: PA12 SLS preferred; ASA or PETG-CF FDM; machinable polymer for CNC
process: SLS/MJF or enclosed-chamber FDM; CNC requires alternate cable-clamp and vent-baffle details
notes: GPT-5.6 SOL REVISION: production refinement of oz51x-dual-rx-housing-vertical v1. Critical module, SMA, header, SC/APC, DE-9, screw, pass-slot, corridor, spool outer diameter, and envelope coordinates are unchanged.

STRUCTURE: 2 mm exterior corner radii remove stress risers; module supports and M3 bosses have 0.8 mm wider tapered roots while retaining their exact top contact and hole locations; all thread-forming pilots gain 0.6 mm screw lead-ins.

MATERIAL EFFICIENCY: the 30 mm solid spool becomes an annular drum with a central screw hub, three radial webs, and 1.5 mm-overhang end flanges. Its fiber-contact radius remains 15 mm. The 3 mm service cover uses 0.6 mm recessed fields separated by full-thickness transverse stiffening lands.

SERVICE AND ROUTING: four molded tie saddles organize pigtails and the DE-9 harness without piercing the enclosure. Spool end flanges retain fiber wraps while the side cover is removed. Connector mouths have 0.35 mm x 0.6 mm insertion lead-ins; screw counterbores have 0.3 mm edge breaks.

ENVIRONMENT: each module gets three horizontal passive vent slots located opposite its header harness. A 3 mm-offset internal splash baffle blocks direct ingress. A cross-drain joins the upper and lower bays, with downward 3 mm outlets from the lower bay and fiber plenum.

TOLERANCE: the service-cover registration clearance is 0.4 mm diametral/per-side geometry allowance for production polymer processes. Use M3x6 thread-forming module screws, the established lid screws, and verify pilot sizing with the final material/process coupon.

ASSUMPTIONS: installation is inside a larger equipment enclosure, vents are acceptable, and the housing is mounted in the modeled upright attitude. The vent labyrinth is drip/debris resistant, not an IP-rated seal. PA12 SLS/MJF is preferred for isotropic saddles, baffles, and drain geometry; use supports/process tuning for FDM.
